title: MI40042: Tunneling And Underground Space Technology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Rock mass classification, RMR and Q-system, stability analysis of tunnels,
elastic and plastic deformation, stress conditions, support requirement of a
tunnel under various types of rocks, tunnel boring machine, selection criteria,
tunneling under massive structures, numerical modeling of tunnels. Tunnel
ventilation.
